title: 2003 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Hiroshi Masuoka / Andreas Schulz (Mitsubishi) and Richard Sainct (KTM)
summary: The 2003 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 16 stage towns and bivouacs through France, Spain, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt. Winners — Cars: Hiroshi Masuoka / Andreas Schulz (Mitsubishi); Bikes: Richard Sainct (KTM); Trucks: Vladimir Chagin / Semen Yakubov / Sergey Savostin (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
